primary_metric: presence_auc_validate: AUC of P(cluster gets >=1 maker BUY fill on side s in 10-s bin) over all (BTC 5m window, side, bin in [0,300) s) of VALIDATE, point-in-time features, no own-state

hypotheses.description: fill prices track Binance 1-s fair value; scan of shift k in [-10,+6] s
hypotheses.verdict: no lead over public Binance 1-s data: prices best match spot ~1-2 s before the block timestamp (consistent with real-time public feed + block latency); no information wall

hypotheses.description: where is the cluster's bid when hit (600 sampled BUILD sweeps)
hypotheses.verdict: confirmed: top-of-book maker, usually alone at the best level; 85% of its fills are mint matches against takers buying the other side

hypotheses.description: side where Binance fair - last print is larger
side whose bids were hit more in the last 10/30 s
presence per (window, side, 10-s bin) from time, Binance fair/returns/vol, taker tape state and flow
hypotheses.verdict: best so far (0.77); +0.04 over market activity alone; below the 0.85 target

hypotheses.description: H8 + own shares bought on each side before the bin
hypotheses.verdict: inventory matters (+0.05): consistent with inventory-skewed quoting; reported separately as required

hypotheses.description: fill price = last taker print on its side before the fill - 0.01 (0.01 grid)
hypotheses.verdict: weak; fill-time version reported by final_rule

hypotheses.description: three wallets = three instances of one bot
hypotheses.verdict: confirmed descriptively: same side signal, own size signature, rarely filled in the same taker order (2.5%)
VALIDATE is a different regime: activity fell ~60% and the BTC 5m maker edge turned negative

hypotheses.description: which windows the cluster trades, from public pre-window features (vol, hour, pre-window prints, |60s return|, previous window activity of the market)
hypotheses.verdict: unpredictable from public data (AUC 0.54); it is the main gap to the presence target: with oracle on/off the presence AUC would be 0.866

hypotheses.description: vol lookback 120-3600 s and vol scale 0.7-2.0; vol x1.4 (300-900 s) cuts MAD(price - fair) 0.068 -> 0.058
hypotheses.verdict: the fills look like a fair value with ~1.4x the 1-s realized vol, but it does not improve presence or side

hypotheses.family: book proxies from the taker tape
hypotheses.description: last bid-hit / ask-lift price per side, ages, fair minus them
which taker orders inside BTC 5m windows fill a cluster maker order (LightGBM, print-time features incl. the print's own size/price)
hypotheses.verdict: promising but not the brief's match_test (no rotation null, no stratification); print size is the top feature (book-depth mechanics)

data_sources: on-chain OrderFilled logs (V2 exchanges, maker topic = cluster) 2026-10-09..H via polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com (chain_fills_*.parquet, 109,822 fills)

data-api taker tapes [start-900, end) of all 4,032 BTC 5m windows (taker_5m_<lo>_<hi>.parquet, ~6.0M rows)
